senses.gloss:
तिष्ठत् तिष्ठत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (pres. part. fr.
rt. स्था), staying, remaining, abiding, standing,
being, &c.
—तिष्ठद्-गु, ind. (गु fr. गो), at
milking-time (when the cows stand to be milked),
after sunset.
—तिष्ठद्-धोम (˚अत्-हो˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. (a sacrifice) at which the oblation is offered
standing, (opposed to उपविष्ट-होम.)

तिष्य तिष्य, अस्, m., N. of a mythical
being who like Kṛśānu is a kind of heavenly
archer; an asterism regarded as shaped like an
arrow and containing three stars, of which δ Cancri
is one, (it is the sixth Nakṣatra of the old or eighth
of the new order, and is also called Puṣya and
Sidhya); the month Pauṣa (December-January);
a common N. of men, ‘born under the asterism
Tishya’ [cf. उप-तिष्य]; (आ), f. Terminalia To-
mentosa; Emblica Officinalis; Emblic Myrobalan;
(अस्, अम्), m. n. the Kali-yuga, the fourth or present
age; (अस्, आ, अम्), auspicious, fortunate, lucky (?).
—तिष्य-केतु, उस्, m. an epithet of Śiva.
—तिष्य-
पुनर्वसीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the asterisms
Tiṣya and Punar-vasu.
—तिष्य-पुष्पा, f. Emblic
Myrobalan (आमलकी).
—तिष्य-फला, f. Emblic
Myrobalan.
—तिष्य-रक्षिता, f., N. of the first
wife of Aśoka.
तिष्यक, अस्, m. the month Pauṣa.

तिसृ तिसृ, तिस्रस्, f. pl. three; see त्रि,
—तिसृ-धन्व, अम्, n., Ved. a bow with three
arrows.
तिसृका, f., N. of a Grāma.
तिस्रा, f. the grass Andropogon Aciculatus.

तीसट तीसट, अस्, m., N. of a writer on
medicine.

तिस्तिराण, अस्, आ, अम् (Perf. part. A.), Ved. one
who has spread, spreading.
